method: DERIVED footprint: a rectangle 23.23 m long (along the axis) and 9.8 m wide (across), the plan view of the main spectrometer vessel ('23.23 m long and has an inner diameter of 9.8 m', src:geo-kit-katrin-design-paper), centred on z = 0 of the beam axis (geometry:kit-katrin-beamline-axis). The real vessel is a cylinder with conical end sections, so the rectangle slightly overstates the corners. PLACEMENT (the same for the axis and the vessel footprint). Direction: the KATRIN Collaboration writes 'The experiment has an orientation of xi ~ 16 deg east to the local north N' (src:geo-kit-katrin-lorentz-2022); the long sides of the OSM KATRIN outline (way 394890935) run at 15.8-16.1 deg, which is independent agreement, not an input. Positions along the axis: Table 1 of src:geo-kit-katrin-aircoil-2013 gives the centres of the coil systems relative to the centre of the main spectrometer (z = 0): WGTS -38.87 m, DPS -27.25, CPS -20.58, pre-spectrometer coils -16.46 and -12.10, pinch coil +12.18, detector coil +13.78. Where z = 0 lies on the ground is NOT published; it was bounded by three facts: (1) the main spectrometer vessel, 23.23 m long and 9.8 m in diameter (src:geo-kit-katrin-design-paper), lies inside the OSM KATRIN outline; (2) the detector coil (z = +13.78 m) lies inside the same outline; (3) the WGTS (z = -38.87 m) stands in Tritium Laboratory building 452 ('Rear system and WGTS will be installed in the existing TLK building'; 'The Tritium Laboratory (building 452)'; src:geo-kit-katrin-tdr-2004) whose OSM outline is way 99082477. In the 16-degree frame (a along the axis, b to the left, origin 49.0957 N 8.4360 E) the outline is a 53 m x 19 m stepped polygon; scanning z = 0 over a 0.25 m grid, the placements satisfying (1)-(3) span a = -13.3 to +14.0 m and b = -1.8 to +7.5 m (1806 of the grid points); adding the pre-spectrometer coils inside the outline narrows a to -8.5..+14.0 m, and adding the DPS and CPS (the TDR puts the transport system in a new building that 'will become part of TLK') narrows it to +2.3..+14.0 m. z = 0 is drawn at the centre of the set (a = 6.4 m, b = 3.0 m, i.e. 49.0957631 N, 8.4359846 E); the largest distance from it to any feasible placement is 19.7 m, hence accuracy_m 20. Everything relative (the 52.65 m between coil-system centres, the 16 deg direction) is sourced; the absolute position inside the hall is not. Haversine perimeter of the drawn rectangle: 66.051 m.
